description: A climate-adapted management plan for Kis-Sarret combines water-regime management, habitat protection and control of invasive species. The case connects changing drought conditions to wetland and grazing management. The resource is documented by European Environment Agency, Climate-ADAPT (case-study publisher). The application is located in Kis-Sarret, Koros-Maros National Park. This is a narrative case, not a regularly gridded or periodically sampled dataset; intervention dates and later updates are given in the source. The case narrative is freely readable as a web page. A licence for reusing the underlying project data is not established. Reported interventions and projected benefits must be distinguished; the case does not supply a ready-to-run simulation. It can inform green-blue infrastructure adaptation scenarios, intervention assumptions and institutional constraints.
